skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply modern data analysis methods for both quantitative and qualitative data.
Proficient in using statistical software for data analysis.
Evaluate and interpret results from data analysis models.
Construct and implement data analysis models in real-world scenarios.
Present results from data analysis models effectively.
Work collaboratively in groups to solve data analysis problems.
Develop the ability to learn independently and conduct self-research.
Understand social context and professional ethics.
Make decisions based on scientific evidence derived from data analysis.

prerequisite_courses: Thống kê trong kinh tế và kinh doanh
